CHD uses the deduplicated operation union per service, ordered distinct operation pairs, denominator n^2 (singleton zero). CMQ uses attribute-name Jaccard, global within-service mean minus cross-service mean with pair denominators, not reference strength. Instability is the mean over ALL services of provided/(provided+required), isolated service=1. UCM combines common actors, explicit scenarios and access-vector cosine; do not fabricate scenario links. CMQ uses attribute-name Jaccard, global within-service mean minus cross-service mean with pair denominators, not reference strength. Instability is the mean over ALL services of provided/(provided+required), isolated service=1. UCM combines common actors, explicit scenarios and access-vector cosine; do not fabricate scenario links. Instability is the mean over ALL services of provided/(provided+required), isolated service=1. UCM combines common actors, explicit scenarios and access-vector cosine; do not fabricate scenario links.
